designationHistory.indexText: Established on November 6, 1980, after the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the refuge on May 20, 1980, to protect bottomland hardwood forest for wintering waterfowl.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval, May 20, 1980

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Overflow National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Encyclopedia of Arkansas: Overflow National Wildlife Refuge (established Nov. 6, 1980)
FWS news release, June 3, 1980: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission authorized "Overflow Bottoms" refuge on May 20, 1980

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date from the Encyclopedia of Arkansas, MBCC approval from the FWS release.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Overflow National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) was established in 1980 to protect the bottomland hardwood forest, a vital habitat for migratory waterfowl populations along the Mississippi Flyway.
